'''Brian Guthrie''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 81 from Austin, Tx. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He played Decipher's Star Trek CCG with [[Eric Berger]] in Austin from 1995, then SWCCG, and went with him to the 1997 Texas regional at Texas A&M University.<ref name="ars">[https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2015/12/that-one-time-i-played-in-the-star-wars-card-game-world-championship/ That one time I played in the Star Wars card game world championship], Eric Berger, Ars Technica (5 December 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009010838/https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2015/12/that-one-time-i-played-in-the-star-wars-card-game-world-championship/ Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
